narrative: On the board. The sheet is full. Ninety lines, no blots, the room already hot. The last speech is the Prince's, a short one, death for the next offence. A note in the margin is in your hand. Gib is still asleep on the Golding. The Lent blank is still open on the other leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Finished the ninety and wrote the count in the margin.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Slept on the Golding through the whole of it.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in Ninety, and not the Prince's words
